children: Differentials for U.S. WTI Midland delivered to Europe narrowed on Monday as two cargoes traded.
Indications are free on board unless marked as cost, insurance and freight or delivered at place.

WTI Midland: Vitol bought an October 16 to 20 cargo from Glencore at dated Brent plus $17 CIF Rotterdam, and TotalEnergies bought an October 21 to 25 cargo from Occidental at dated plus $17.30 CIF Rotterdam.
The midpoint of the day's deals, dated plus $17.15 CIF, equated to a $14.79 premium to dated Brent on a FOB basis, Reuters calculations showed.
On Friday, Vitol bought WTI cargoes at $17.30 and $18.30.
Troll: Trafigura bid for an October 14 to 16 cargo at dated Brent plus $18.65 FOB Mongstad.
